title: Release Target
description: Link this staging repository to a release repository. Promotions from here default to the linked target, and promotions elsewhere are rejected. The target must be a local repository using the same <format>{format}</format> format.
notStagingDescription: Release-target promotion links artifacts from a staging repository to a release repository.
notStaging: Release targets are only available for staging repositories. This repository is a {type} repository.
noCandidates: No eligible release repositories found. Create a local {format} repository to use as a release target.
